name: pnp-sharepoint-skills-send-customer-packet
title: Send Customer Packet
shortDescription: Prepares and sends the customer packet email with a view-only link, gated on Packet status and an explicit confirmation of the exact preview.
longDescription: Reads the packet's columns, fills an email template from them, creates a view-only sharing link for the selected file only, and shows To, Subject and body.
Sends only after "Confirm to send" for that exact preview, then sets Packet status to Customer Sent. Never sends when required columns are missing.
